title: Insulin Pharmacy Tiers: Payment Plan, Small-Balance, Hardship and Credit Refund Terms
content:
Financial counseling terms for the customer's balance on the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program differ by tier in seven figures.

| Term | What the figure is |
|---|---|
| Payment plan minimum balance | The smallest patient balance, in USD, for which an interest-free payment plan may be requested |
| Payment plan maximum months | The longest interest-free payment plan, in monthly installments; 0 means payment plans are not offered on the tier |
| Payment plan minimum installment | The smallest monthly installment accepted on a payment plan, in USD |
| Small-balance write-off ceiling | The largest remaining patient balance, in USD, that is written off as a small balance instead of being statemented; 0.00 means no small-balance write-off on the tier |
| Hardship waiver allowed | Whether a documented financial-hardship waiver of patient cost share may be granted case by case on the tier |
| Hardship income ceiling | The household income ceiling for a financial-hardship waiver, as an integer percent of the current HHS federal poverty guideline for the household size |
| Credit balance refund limit | The time limit for refunding a customer credit balance (overpayment), in calendar days counted from the posting date of the entry that created the credit |

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Plan min. balance (USD) | Plan max. months | Min. installment (USD) | Small-balance ceiling (USD) | Hardship waiver | Hardship income ceiling | Credit refund (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | 150.00 | 0 | 25.00 | 0.00 | Not allowed | 200% | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | 150.00 | 6 | 25.00 | 4.99 | Allowed | 200% | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | 150.00 | 6 | 25.00 | 4.99 | Allowed | 200% | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | 100.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 4.99 | Allowed | 200% | 60 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | 100.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 0.00 | Allowed | 200% | 60 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | 100.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 0.00 | Allowed | 200% | 60 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | 100.00 | 0 | 20.00 | 0.00 | Not allowed | 200% | 60 |

## Notes on the table

- Payment plans exist only where the maximum months figure is above 0: the Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO, Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug, Medicare Part D and Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Programs. The Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program and the Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program list a minimum balance and a minimum installment but show 0 months, so no plan is offered there.
- A small-balance write-off exists only on the three tiers whose ceiling is 4.99; on the tiers showing 0.00 there is no small-balance write-off.
- The hardship income ceiling reads 200% on every tier, but a hardship waiver may be granted only on the tiers marked "Allowed".
